2:154.text: And say not of those who are killed in the Way of Allâh, "They are dead." Nay, they are living, but you perceive

2:155.text: And certainly, We shall test you with something of fear, hunger, loss of wealth, lives and fruits, but give glad tidings to As-Sâbirûn

2:156.text: Who, when afflicted with calamity, say: "Truly! To Allâh we belong and truly, to Him we shall return."

2:157.text: They are those on whom are the Salawât
(i.e. who are blessed and will be forgiven)
receive His Mercy, and it is they who are the guided ones.

2:158.text: are of the Symbols of Allâh. So it is not a sin on him who performs Hajj or ‘Umrah
And whoever does good voluntarily, then verily, Allâh is All-Recogniser, All-Knower.

2:159.text: Verily, those who conceal the clear proofs, evidence and the guidance, which We have sent down, after We have made it clear for the people in the Book, they are the ones cursed by Allâh and cursed by the cursers.

2:160.text: Except those who repent and do righteous deeds, and openly declare
. These, I will accept their repentance. And I am the One Who accepts repentance, the Most Merciful.

2:161.text: Verily, those who disbelieve, and die while they are disbelievers, it is they on whom is the Curse of Allâh and of the angels and of mankind, combined.

2:162.text: , their punishment will neither be lightened, nor will they be reprieved.

2:163.text: (there is none who has the right to be worshipped but He)
, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
